title: Family Twin: recalculation time on the hosted server
method: POST /api/twin/what-if on the hosted API (Azure Container Apps, UAE North, 2 vCPU / 4 GiB, one replica), straight after a redeploy. 'server_ms' is the engine time the API reports and the page shows; 'round_trip_ms' also includes the network from the measuring laptop (outside the UAE), so it is specific to that connection. 61 people, six cousin marriages, exact inference.

laptop_in_process.note: Same calculation run in process on the development laptop (Apple silicon), no network.

reading: On the hosted server a recalculation takes about 0.7 s with no extra results and about 0.9 s (0.7 to 1.2 s) once results are recorded; the first call after a restart took 1.0 s. An earlier README said 'under a second, about 0.7 s hosted'; that was true only for the no-extra-results case.
